shortDescription: Configure port using NPU or Intel-NIC.

options.name: access_token
options.description: The token to access FortiManager without using username and password.

options.name: bypass_validation
options.description: Only set to True when module schema diffs with FortiManager API structure, module continues to execute without validating parameters.

options.name: forticloud_access_token
options.description: Authenticate Ansible client with forticloud API access token.

options.name: proposed_method
options.description: The overridden method for the underlying Json RPC request.

options.name: rc_failed
options.description: The rc codes list with which the conditions to fail will be overriden.

options.name: rc_succeeded
options.description: The rc codes list with which the conditions to succeed will be overriden.

options.name: revision_note
options.description: The change note that can be specified when an object is created or updated.

options.name: workspace_locking_adom
options.description: The adom to lock for FortiManager running in workspace mode, the value can be global and others including root.

options.name: workspace_locking_timeout
options.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for other user to release the workspace lock.
